generations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
EDIT IMAGE 1 in place. It is the correctly registered hair-only cap for Solar Friends idle pose 5, on a mostly empty 1254×1254 transparent canvas. Change ONLY the curly texture into the chestnut SIDE-PART hairstyle shown in image 2. Image 2 is hairstyle/paint identity ONLY: do NOT copy its size or canvas coordinates. Do not resize, warp or stretch an existing image. Repaint at the unchanged image-1 position. Only the small registered cap is painted; all other canvas pixels stay transparent.
